title: Can We Jump from Cross-Sectional to Dynamic Interpretations of Networks? Implications for the Network Perspective in Psychiatry
limitations: - Cross-sectional networks may not reflect causal symptom dynamics; - Limited to 7 mood items; - No formal statistical test for centrality comparisons; - Data not publicly available.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the paper, but the authors may have made them available through supplementary materials or repositories. The centrality measures were computed but not formally tested for statistical significance between groups.
